utils

Class CleanupUtility

  • java.lang.Object
    • utils.CleanupUtility

  • public class CleanupUtility
extends Object
    Utility for cleaning up generated CSV files and experiment image directories in a Paint project workspace.

    The tool supports both command-line and programmatic usage.

    Command-line usage

    
 java utils.CleanupUtility <root-directory> <mode> [--dry-run] [--old | --all]

    Modes

    • TRACKMATE – deletes Recordings*, All Tracks*, and SQUARES_CSV* files, plus the directories Brightfield Images and TrackMate Images.
    • GENERATE_SQUARES – deletes only SQUARES_CSV* files.

    Options

    • --dry-run – only prints what would be deleted, without deleting anything.
    • --old – targets legacy CSV names (without " Java" suffix).
    • --all – targets both legacy and new CSV names. If --old and --all are both specified, --all takes precedence.

    Programmatic usage

    
 CleanupUtility.runCleanup(Paths.get("/path/to/project"), "TRACKMATE", true, false, true);
    This call would perform a dry run of deleting all matching files (both legacy and new names) in TRACKMATE mode.

      • main

        public static void main(String[] args)
        Command-line entry point.

        Parses CLI arguments, validates options, and delegates to runCleanup(Path, String, boolean, boolean, boolean). Terminates the JVM with a non-zero status code on errors.

        Parameters:
        args - CLI arguments (see class-level Javadoc for usage)

      • runCleanup

        public static void runCleanup(Path rootDir,
                              String mode,
                              boolean dryRun,
                              boolean old,
                              boolean all)
                       throws IOException
        Executes cleanup of CSV files and experiment directories.
        Parameters:
        rootDir - project root directory
        mode - cleanup mode must be either TRACKMATE or GENERATE_SQUARES
        dryRun - if true, only print what would be deleted without removing anything
        old - if true, target only legacy CSV names (without " Java" suffix); ignored if all is true
        all - if true, target both legacy and new CSV names (overrides old if both are set)
        Throws:
        IOException - if filesystem traversal or deletion fails
